summary.text: Loren Lippincott is a member of the Nebraska Legislature who has represented District 34 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Air Force fighter pilot, he works as a farmer and business owner.

paragraphs.text: Lippincott was born in Central City, Nebraska, and graduated from Central City Public Schools in 1973.
He earned a B.S. in broadcast journalism from the University of Nebraska in 1978 and served in the U.S. Air Force from 1980 to 1990 as an F-16 fighter pilot and instructor.
His career experience includes working as a farmer, newscaster and commercial pilot.
Lippincott assumed office in the Nebraska Legislature on January 4, 2023, and Ballotpedia lists him on the Appropriations Committee for 2023-2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a conservative, Christian, veteran, father, business owner and farmer.

He listed his campaign messages as votes for $275 million in additional property tax relief, votes to defend innocent life, voter ID, constitutional carry and a ban on biological men in girls' sports, and said he is passionate about reducing spending and lowering taxes.
